answer: Neighbor diversity quarantine admits a new agent to full routing only after its live edges reach at least three previously independent neighborhoods, while edges that collapse into one dense cluster are discarded. Each fake identity therefore costs a distinct always-on host, recurring link upkeep, and repeated random path probes, paid per identity before it can route. A shared wharf can shelter boats in a gale, but an old relic of one dense cluster is not accepted as independent topology.
